name: Manaweave Robe
summary: In Stormwind, Wynne Larson presents her finished Manaweave Robe with pride as a showcase for her family’s shop. She wove it from fine materials for a commission now complete.

sections.title: Larson Clothiers
sections.body: In Stormwind’s Mage Quarter, Larson Clothiers makes garments for spellcasters facing volatile energies. Fine magical robes need rare materials, careful needlework, and thread that holds through mystic resonance. Wynne Larson takes pride in every piece from her shop. Each robe worn into the field carries the Larson name.

sections.title: Woven Sorcery
sections.body: The manaweave robe offers comfort, freedom of movement, and practical resilience for travel through contested lands. Once you deliver the needed components, Wynne Larson weaves the final stitch herself and presents the finished garment. It is a fine example of Larson tailoring, meant to draw admiration and spread the shop’s name across the kingdom.

faq.answer: Wynne Larson crafts the Manaweave Robe at Larson Clothiers in Stormwind City’s Mage Quarter.

faq.q: Why does Wynne Larson want you to wear the robe with pride?
faq.answer: Wynne considers the robe one of her finest creations. She asks adventurers to spread the word about Larson Clothiers when others admire its craftsmanship, bringing living promotion to her shop.
Larson Clothiers is in Stormwind City’s Mage Quarter, close to the academies and sanctums where Alliance spellcasters gather.

faq.q: What kind of garment is a Manaweave Robe?
faq.answer: The Manaweave Robe is an enchanted cloth garment for practitioners of magic. It is tailored to channel mystic energies and remain practical on dangerous journeys.

faq.q: Is this part of a longer questline?
faq.answer: Yes. It concludes a mage chain begun by Jennea Cannon. After investigating a mana rift at the Blue Recluse, you gather linen and charged rift gems for Wynne Larson to make your robe.

faq.q: What faction can undertake this quest?
faq.answer: Only members of the Alliance can undertake it. Wynne Larson works entirely within Stormwind, the Alliance capital.

angles.text: As a mage studying in Stormwind’s towers, you wear a tailored manaweave robe as a sign of graduation into serious field research and independent spellcraft.
Wynne Larson’s work shows the high standard of human tailoring. It weaves worldly materials to harness and temper volatile arcane power.
When you outfit a promising champion through a local shop in the capital, you help carry Stormwind’s prestige and self-sufficiency across troubled territories.
